title: Tâches planifiées
description: Scheduled tasks of this computer: Windows Task Scheduler (all tasks, hidden ones included; the list shows those outside \Microsoft\), Linux systemd timers (system and user) and cron jobs (user crontab, /etc/crontab, /etc/cron.d, anacron, /etc/cron.<period> scripts): schedule, command (obvious secrets masked), account, enabled, last run and result, next run. Summary, failed tasks, suspicious tasks (program in a temporary or public folder, encoded or downloading command, misused system tools, unsigned program in a user-writable folder, reverse shell) and the next runs. Findings flag failed (TSK-FAILED), suspicious (TSK-SUSPICIOUS) and missed tasks. Creating or deleting a task is never offered.

functions.name: list
functions.title: Liste des tâches
functions.help: Liste les tâches planifiées (Planificateur de tâches, minuteries systemd, crons) filtrées par texte, état et source. Décocher « Tâches Microsoft » sous Windows pour ne garder que celles ajoutées par des logiciels.
functions.description: Scheduled tasks filtered by text (name, folder, command), state (enabled, disabled, failed, suspicious) and source (system, user, cron); Windows \Microsoft\ tasks can be left out.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.label: Filtre
parameters.description: Keep only tasks whose name, folder or command contains this text.

parameters.name: state
parameters.label: État
parameters.description: all, enabled, disabled, failed or suspicious.

parameters.name: source
parameters.label: Source
parameters.description: all, system (Task Scheduler / systemd system timers), user (systemd --user) or cron.

functions.name: get_task
functions.title: Détail d'une tâche
functions.help: Détail d'une tâche planifiée : planification, commande, compte, dernière exécution et résultat, et l'historique de ses exécutions.
functions.description: One scheduled task in detail: schedule, command, account, state, last run and result, next run, suspicious signs, and the history of its runs (Linux: journal of the service it starts; Windows: TaskScheduler/Operational log when enabled).

parameters.name: name
parameters.label: Tâche
parameters.description: Task name or path (Windows \Folder\Name), or timer name (Linux, with or without .timer).

functions.name: run
functions.title: Exécuter une tâche
functions.help: Lance une tâche planifiée tout de suite, sans attendre son heure. Les crons et, sous Linux, les tâches du système (sans root) sont refusés.
functions.description: Runs a scheduled task now (Windows: Task Scheduler Run; Linux: starts the service of the systemd timer). Blocked for cron jobs, for system timers without root, for a disabled Windows task and for a task already running.

parameters.name: name
parameters.label: Tâche
parameters.description: Task name or path, or timer name.

functions.name: set_enabled
functions.title: Activer / désactiver une tâche
functions.help: Active ou désactive une tâche planifiée. Sous Linux, décocher « Aussi aux prochains démarrages » pour ne l'arrêter que jusqu'au prochain redémarrage. Annulable depuis l'Audit.
functions.description: Enables or disables a scheduled task (Windows: task Enabled; Linux: systemctl [--user] enable/disable --now of the timer, or start/stop). Blocked for cron jobs, system timers without root and essential maintenance timers. Undoable.

parameters.name: name
parameters.label: Tâche
parameters.description: Task name or path, or timer name.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.label: Activée
parameters.description: true to enable, false to disable.

parameters.name: persistent
parameters.label: Aussi aux prochains démarrages
parameters.description: Linux: true = systemctl enable/disable --now (kept after a reboot); false = start/stop only until the next boot. A timer started by another unit without being enabled is only stopped. Ignored on Windows.
